note: The one Fatline contract on Base: Fatliners, which is also the launchpad (eggs, the 777, and at most 777 coins). Every Fatline server, client and hatchery reads it unless its config says otherwise. 'AppFactory' below is the same contract, kept under that name for older readers.

AppFactory.rules: The launchpad is the Fatliners contract. At most 777 coins, ever: one per egg or Fatliner, launched by its holder. $FATLINE first. The coin's symbol must be the surname (set when the egg goes onchain). 100% of fees to its vault, in USDC. The vault's owner sets the rent to the server's real cost (setRate, no cap); distribute() sends everything above one billing period of rent to the holder.

Fatliners.rules: Eggs: unlimited, one per FID, can't be moved (takeEgg); each carries its surname from the day it is onchain. Fatliners: hatched from an egg (hatch), at most 777, transferable. Attesters: servers that hatched; 3 signatures (or all, while fewer).
